study type: Analysis of a nationally representative birth cohort
cohort: 12,450 mother-child pairs from the UK Millennium Cohort Study, born between 2000-2002
finding: Gestational hypertension was weakly positively associated with asthma in offspring, and this association was partly mediated by earlier delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that part of the association between gestational hypertension and asthma was mediated by earlier delivery, suggesting a potential indirect link through mode of delivery.
